description: Read what the caller's organization spent credits on this month, as the web app's usage page shows it. since is the start of the current UTC month, and creditsSpent counts the credits spent since then. creditsByKind splits them by what they bought: spend for charged searches, turn for charged assistant turns, reveal for contact reveals, and private_campaign for campaigns made private, and chargedSearches, assistantTurns, contactReveals, and privateCampaigns count each kind's charges. allowance holds the caller's free daily uses: limit, remaining (the uses left today, never more than what is left of the 200 everyone in the organization shares), and resetAt, the next UTC midnight in epoch milliseconds. Needs a credential.
name: get_usage_statement
title: Get usage statement
